interface.signature: def chess_board(rows: int, columns: int) -> list[list[str]]: ...

preconditions.description: Both `rows` and `columns` must be positive integers.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == rows and all(len(row) == columns for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: The returned 2D array must have exactly `rows` rows and each row must have exactly `columns` elements.

postconditions.expression: all(all(cell in ('O', 'X') for cell in row) for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every cell in the returned array must be either 'O' or 'X'.
The top-left cell (first row, first column) must always be 'O'.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i][j] != return_value[i][j + 1] for i in range(rows) for j in range(columns - 1))
postconditions.description: Adjacent cells in the same row must alternate between 'O' and 'X'.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i][j] != return_value[i + 1][j] for i in range(rows - 1) for j in range(columns))
postconditions.description: Adjacent cells in the same column must alternate between 'O' and 'X'.
